ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

file-upload.description: Dropzone, button, avatar, and field control for selecting local files, with validation, per-file progress, URL attach, upload modes, and an image editor.

editor.note: Open the editor in a dialog, position the image under the mask, and save. Saving emits a new image file.

examples.label: Attachments
examples.note: Dropzone with drag and drop, validation, and a file list. Files stay selected until you wire an upload URL.

installation.note: Install the Solaris UI package and import the file upload and image editor components.

modes.note: Dropzone is a full panel with drag and drop; button is a compact trigger, avatar is a photo panel with editor wiring, and field is a single-line row at the form-field height for forms. Tune size and density to preview every variant across scenarios.

props.note: Props table coming soon with the table component.

size-density.note: Size and density combine into a 3x3 matrix: the dropzone panel adjusts min-height, padding, typography and icon, and keeps the same size while dragging over.

file-upload.title: File upload

upload.note: Automatic uploads start immediately with progress; manual uploads wait for uploadAll(). Both demos below use a simulated handler.

url.note: With allowUrl, a URL row downloads a remote file into the selection, running the same validation.
